notes.title: Final Cut Changelog - v1.0.7 - March 17 - New Global Event
notes.notes:
Updates to The Incredible Adventures of Van Helsing III have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client (in on-line mode) is restarted. 

New Global Event: Lycantrope Hunt
Vrikolaks are fierce man-beasts with strong territorial instincts. The rapid industrialization of modern Borgovia led to the deforestation of the Thunderhead Mountains and the shapeshifter tribes lost their hunting grounds. They have also been forced into a constant battle for survival. The Vrikolaks are, understandably, furious. They don't care that Professor Fulmigati is gone, they are busy unleashing their mindless rage on the population of the metropolis. The Vrikolak attacks reached the level where they've left no other choice: they must be hunted down until they learn the lesson.

Scenarios now spawn Vrikolaks of various strength among regular monsters
Hunt down a thousand Vrikolaks to get to their leader
Fight the Scarred Beast-King for epic rewards
After every 1000 kill, a new Vrikolak leader will arrive
Conquer the leaderboard by slaughtering as many Vrikolaks as you can!
Event goes live at 19:00 CET.

General Fixes

Fixed an issue where the game does not start from Steam on some accounts.
The Arcane Forge no longer deletes epics when used at full inventory.
Fixed the Polish localization of the game where dialog lines were skipping a line.
Fixed Saffi's Transmute skill that sometimes deducted money from players without doing anything.

Quests

The Gnome Beard Grease secret now counts properly.
Fragment of Koschei's Death now drops properly.
Hell Kitchen book now drops properly.
Fixed a bug where the game displayed incorrect skill values for Resistance Captains.
Fixed the quest counter for the Ink Hunt quests.
Saffi now rewards players with her ring properly when they complete the quest.
The Octopod Annihilator now properly spawns at the end of the Viaduct Junction siege.

Skills

Fixed the Devastator Perk.
Fixed the animation of the Whirlwind spell that was bugged when players used Ghastly Shape.

Items

Fixed the damage of the Vorpal Dagger.
Fixed the damage of the Twilight Dagger.
Players are now unable to improve Godlike items above the 10th upgrade level.
The Eldritch Protector Shield now has a new icon that resembles the shield model.
Fixed the bonus +%Defense enchant on the Honoriad Helmet.
Fixed the set bonuses of the Apocryphus Mechanicus Pack.
Fixed the set bonuses of the Runic Spirit Ring.

Multiplayer

Clients can now access to the Chimera properly.
Endgame chests will now only reward the player who opened them.
Added additional protection to the IP location service that will help players in connecting to their friends.

Scenarios

Totems in adventure mode can now be properly destroyed.
Fixed an issue where players did not receive their rewards after completing a scenario in co-op.
The "Survive 50 waves in the arena" challenge now works properly.

notes.title: Final Cut Changelog - v1.0.6 - Feb 4 - Introducing Global Events
notes.notes:
Updates to Van Helsing: Final Cut have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client (in on-line mode) is restarted. 

New Feature: Global Events

Players can now compete in the Adventure mode by finding Target Monsters in random scenarios. Each scenario has a 50% chance of spawning a Target Monster that hoards some significant treasure. Kill enough of them and you will receive additional rewards at certain kill counts:

10 kills: Gray Bag of Loot
25 kills: Brown Bag of Loot
50 kills: Golden Bag of Loot
100 kills: Purple Bag of Loot

https://youtu.be/KuHDzQUauoU
Game Fixes

The Respawn window no longer appears when players die with a HC character.
Fixed a missing texture in the Old Town.
Fixed an issue where the login screen did not take the correct password after logging out with autologin enabled.
Fixed a typo in the Poison Damage enchantment.
Fixed the inventory block that occurred when players were trading.
Fixed a missing string in the login window.

Quests

Siege of Viaduct Junction now rewards the player the items that previously dropped from the Octopod Annihilator.
Fixed scrolling of the radio messages.
The Ink is Coming now should reward players properly.
Dr. Dampf's position is now fixed.

Skills

Fixed animation problems with the Ghastly Shape spell.
Fixed animation problems with the Smite spell.
The Protector can now deflect the Vrikolak's attacks.

Items

Fixed the hidden content banter in the Old town at the fishing shack.
Fixed some chests at the Viaduct Junction that could not be opened.
Fixed the missing string of Saffi's Amulet.
Matthias now sells gloves for Protectors as well.
Fixed infinitely lootable items such as the Grey Wizard's epic gear.
Fixed some unsellable items.

Multiplayer

Fixed a multiplayer crash that occurred since 1.0.5
Fixed an issue where the lobby kept changing regions for games.
The Arena now has a "Waiting for other players" message in multiplayer mode.
Fixed the "X" icon under Steam avatars to indicate its real purpose.
Fixed a missing texture in the player window.
Fixed the missing POI tick on the minimap for the client side during Purge missions.

Achievements

Perfect Plan now works properly.
Incredible Adventures now works properly.

Adventure Mode & Dynamic Events

The Leaderboard now properly tracks score.
Fixed a Daily Quest display mouseover bug.
Fixed a bug with counting score at the leaderboards.
Fixed an issue with scoretracking in Multiplayer.
Fixed a positioning error in the leaderboard.

Balance

Ice Empress/Ice Queen's Lightning Strike has been nerfed significantly.
The last Golem in the Perun bossfight has his Skyblast spell modified. It deals damage on a larger area and is more clearly visible. Damage has been reduced.
Fixed the movement speed of the Elementalist.

notes.title: Final Cut Changelog - v1.0.5 - Jan 28
notes.notes:
Updates to Van Helsing: Final Cut have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client (in on-line mode) is restarted. 


Global Event Support
The game is now capable to run Global Events in Adventure mode. Stay tuned, hunters...

Game Fixes

New executable file for Windows 10 users, fixing launch and stability issues. (Automatically chosen by launching the game from Steam)
Fixed a typo in the description of Confidence Mastery.
Fixed a typo in the description of Toughness Mastery.
Fixed a typo in the description of Stone Rain.
Fixed an issue where players got stuck Beneath the Palace.
Improved the loading time for the first launch of the game.
Fixed an issue where glory points were reset randomly.
Todor Schimko has been trained and now he is a lot more skilled in augmenting Godlike items. By pressing F, you can quickly enhance your items, and also, the item icons are no longer streched.
Replacing stats at Saffi can no longer cause to remove a stat permanently.
Players with special characters in their names are no longer blocked from logging in.
Resistance Captains' models are not showing near the desk after their death.
Fixed a crash upon entering a Clue Hunt map.

Quests

Saffi now properly rewards players carrying the Swamp Lily from Mr. Bellow Smash Jr.
The markers now properly appear for the Rogue Hunter-Machine quest.
The final quest now rewards players properly.
Fixed an issue with Resistance Management Mission timers.
Resistance Management rewards received a complete overhaul.
The Relic Hunt daily quest can no longer be exploited.
Fixed a progress error that occurred when players were teleporting out from the Hideout.

Skills

Fixed an issue where Mirror Image corpses did not disappear in Arena Mode.
Protectors' first Shield Block ability is now blocking properly.
Protectors are now unable to parry while blocking.
Fixed the bonus application issue for Focus Damage's Mastery.
Fixed the icon stacking for the Iron Mage perk.
Removed the Elite Behemoths' Eye for an Eye skill.

Items

Fixed the stats on Manticore Belt.
Fixed the stats on Son of Ramat Amulet.
Fixed the stats on Manticore Boots.
Fixed the stats on Gallowsbog Amulet.
Fixed the Immaculatus Cloak, it now belongs to the proper set.
Fixed the stats on Incantatus Garb.
Fixed the stats on Soulbound Amulet.
Fixed the stats on Behemoth Hunter trophy.
Fixed the set bonuses on Runic Spirit ring.
Fixed the stats on the Chrome Trooper Helmet.
Items with a chance to teleport now no longer port players to secluded locations in TD mode.
Serious overhaul of the essences: Essence costs were changed, effects were moved around.
Fixed an issue that would mess up certain essences you already had in your inventory.
The Bone Relic is now properly dropped by the Frenzied Forest Spirit.
Buffed the base stats of Godlike items.
Fixed an issue with the Scarecrow Hat and the Harpy Feather trophy.
Fixed a missing string for the Gallowsbog Amulet.
Titan Belt's stats can now be unlocked properly.
Items with +bonus HP/mana potion cooldown no longer increase potion cooldown.

Multiplayer

Fixed an issue that caused experience differences between players in co-op mode.
Shadow Fury now properly works in Multiplayer.
Players can now drop stuff on the ground without issues.
Fixed an issue where items were dropped slowly with critters around.

Achievements and Challenges

Fixed the Glory Level Challenge.
The Perfect Plan achievement is now awarded properly.
The Riddle Me Wisp achievement is now awarded properly.

Adventure Mode

Fixed an issue with the Fate Point limit: it is now calculated and displayed properly.
In Clue Hunt scenarios, the time limit has been increased to 12 minutes.
The Arena daily quest now completes properly.
Dying after completing the mission objective will no longer result in losing the mission.
Drastically increased the reward qualities on the first 5 difficulty levels along with the epic chance.

Balance

Adjusted the aggro range for Katarina.
Some of the spells did not benefit from the damage modifiers from the difficulty. This has been fixed in a major balance overhaul and influences a lot of spells, resulting in much less oneshots from monsters.
Items for Katarina are much more likely to drop now. Lucky girl.
The Chimera's Mana Drain has been drastically nerfed.
The Constructor's summoned mechs now implement the skill synergy into their DPS properly.
New damage reflect system: reflects according to the ratio of the incoming damage to the current HP.

notes.title: Van Helsing Final Cut Changelog - V1.0.4 - November 24
notes.notes:
Updates to Van Helsing: Final Cut have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client (in on-line mode) is restarted. 

Game Fixes

The Network Error reconnect message had a missing string, which is now fixed.
Fixed numerous missing strings in the Polish Localization.
Fixed an issue where the game did not start with an 0xc000007b error after the last redist update.
The highlights on the Chimera UI now properly indicate what mission is the Chimera doing at the time.

Quests

Mistress of Keys - the window is now properly dismissed in the Lair.
Fixed spawn issues with several Tower Defense quests, such as the 7th one, Undead Horde.
Fixed an issue where players could not find the Engineer during Protect the Lair.
Added a chat command: "/FixQuest 3" (to be entered into the in-game chat without quotation marks) for those players who got stuck with the Dark Ritual Quest.
Fixed an issue that DX11 players had with Tower Defense maps.

Skills

Fixed the tooltip of Spool of Energy, it now indicates spell placement correctly.
Bounty Hunter passive "Invigorating Hit" now works properly in Multiplayer.
Buffs and auras that require the player to stand still now work properly. (Previously they worked during moving)
Fixed the Corrupted Alchemy affix on bosses, it no longer has an 8-sec cooldown.
The damage calculation for Flame Serpent is now fixed.
The damage calculation for Lightning is now fixed.

Items

Fixed 60+ set/epic items, which will now be stronger and more powerful compared to rare items.
Vitae Pendant can no longer drop randomly.
Arkady the Fence was supposed to handle Godlike forging but he left his tools in his other pants... He will provide this crucial service in Adventure Mode in the Secret Lair from now on. And yes, you will need to spend Fate Points to upgrade Godlike items which will unlock new enchants.
Fixed the gold value of several items.
Any character will be able to receive Set and Godlike items from the next patch, with the usual level 100  requirement, so your keys won't go to waste with a lower level character. Epics, Rares, etc. will still scale to your character when you find them though!
The Chests now provide the proper loot in Adventure mode at all times.

Multiplayer

The Pigasus UI buttons are now fixed on the client side.
The Cancel button in the connect window now works properly.
Fixed an issue with the Poison Blast skill that caused delay in co-op mode.

Achievements

Good Catch is now fixed and works properly.

Adventure Mode

The "Adventure Completed" message will now always be displayed correctly.
The game no longer crashes when a challenge is completed and the challenge window is opened.
Challenge progress is now saved properly.
Daily quests are now properly removed after finishing them.

Balance

Reduced values for essence damage bonuses.
The Umbralist can no longer score insane one-shot damage values from 10 shadow marks, the damage caused by Deadly Marks can no longer crit.
Fixed the damage value of several ranged weapons.
The Elementalist can no longer be constantly invulnerable as the cooldown timer now starts at the end of the Painlessness buff.
Fixed the stacking effect bug at the end of Escort missions.

notes.title: Van Helsing: Final Cut Changelog - V1.0.2 (Nov 12) - Offline Scenarios!
notes.notes:
Updates to Van Helsing: Final Cut have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client (in on-line mode) is restarted. 

New Feature: Offline Scenarios
We have implemented this feature due to the high demand from users. The game now supports full offline mode, and scenarios are now accessible without logging in to your Neocore Account. 

Game Fixes

Hungarian language pack has been added.
Parallax Mapping has been removed and implemented in the base game.
Fixed an issue where Online characters did not load for players (along with the shared stash).
Fixed the window size on the "Fate point limit reached" message window.
Fixed an issue where gold find bonus did not work properly.
Fixed a crash related to essence stacking.
Fixed a display issue with the FullScreen skill tree.
Fixed a crash related to the shopkeeper in Thunderhead Mountain.
Fixed pathing issues for the Gun Platform.
Seekermaton's tooltip now clarifies that an enemy can be targeted by only one Seekermaton.
Added tooltip to the Full Screen Skill Tree button.
The Gorgon Pass Domovoy can't be blocked now.
Fixed the black cutscene at the Sewage Plant.
Fixed a few gigantic models on weapons.
Fixed a few tooltips and text size in the Controller GUI.
Fixed Black Screen after leaving the Lair in Adventure mode.
Fixed the tooltips of the Forge.
Fixed the placement of several tutorial windows.
Fixed the Level Up message placement on certain resolutions.
Katarina no longer stops attacking sometimes without any reason.
Katarina can now be reset properly.
Difficulty can now be changed mid-game with a controller.
Characters can no longer get stuck at the Dreadworks.

Quests

Fixed an issue where Fulmigati died on his own. Now he puts up quite a fight.
Fixed the Challenge progress track, the game now tracks your progress correctly.
Nutty Stefan now rewards you if you give him the Bunny Slayer.
The arena countdown now works properly.
The Gas Projector can always be destroyed from now on.

Skills

Hex Shot is now a Poison skill.
Fixed a missing tooltip for the Scarecrow's Invulnerability spell.

Items

Fixed the Crit Chance on the Orichalcum Shirt.
Greater Quintessence now gives the proper bonuses.
Greater Material essence now has a proper description.
Fixed a minor issue with the Dodge enchant.

Multiplayer

Quick Connect has been fixed and now works with refreshed lobby data.
Fixed various connection issues where players got stuck on pinging.
Removed the Region Filter.

Scenarios

Greater Treasure Chest now scales with Gold Find bonus.
Daily quests now show up correctly.
Fate point rewards are now correctly given.

Balance

Fixed the scaling of Essences.
Ghostly Mirage no longer scales with the difficulty level.
Fixed the damage of all toy soldiers.
Suicidal Domovoy's health has been reduced significantly.

notes.title: Van Helsing: Final Cut release delayed - Sign up for Closed Beta
notes.notes:
The release date for The Incredible Adventures of Van Helsing: Final Cut is delayed from original tentative date of October 7. 

There are, again, good reasons for this.

Before the release of the game, we feel like it should have a short period of a Closed Beta to make sure that every feature is working correctly on the user's end, on multiple hardwares. This is what we can't test on our own, and for a solid release, we deemed it necessary.

So in a way, you can still play it, if you are willing to forgive the unfortunate timing yet again.

Please contact us, if you are willing to do so. For a Closed Beta, you will need:

•	Contact us at beta@neocoregames.com 
•	Detail your hardware specifics (Processor, OS, Video Card, Memory)
•	A contact e-mail
•	Communicate in English well

The Incredible Adventures of Van Helsing: Final Cut will be free for all who own the trilogy, and a new release date will be set as soon as we get the additional testing done.
